summary: [[character:bob-replicant]] and his allies face a large gorilloid assault on the Deltan colony. The [[species:delta-eridani-natives|Deltans]] defend [[character:archimedes]] with spears and a [[technology:hand-axe]], while Bob directs a [[technology:buster-drone]] to stop a breakthrough. The battle leaves heavy Deltan losses and raises concern about recoverable technological wreckage. As the group considers returning the Deltans to their former flint site, [[character:luke]] and [[character:bender]] decide to seek projects elsewhere while [[character:marvin]] stays involved with the Deltans.

introducing.name: hand axe
introducing.description: A large hand axe made by [[character:archimedes]] for Deltan defense. Comparable in scale to a felling axe, it proves effective against gorilloids and becomes a model the other Deltan males want to reproduce.

introducing.name: Battle at the Deltan colony
introducing.description: A large gorilloid assault on the Deltan colony kills thirty [[species:delta-eridani-natives|Deltans]] and injures about fifteen more. The Deltans repel the attackers with their weapons and [[character:bob-replicant]]'s buster-drone intervention, but the losses deepen the danger facing their small community.

updates.description: GUPPI, the General Unit Primary Peripheral Interface, offloads tasks for replicants, who keep human limits on multitasking. Its operating system is firmware, so changing its replication priority would require a new core and ship. Version 2 has enough memory that a personality matrix is contemplated. It handles messages and callbacks and can launch buster drones on order.

A buster drone is an observation drone reinforced internally and fitted with steel impact caps. It can strike with forty pounds of high-tensile steel at twice the speed of a high-powered rifle bullet, delivering a lethal kinetic blow and sonic boom against a gorilloid. Atmospheric entry requires a controlled descent, so a deployment can take about ten minutes to reach a surface target.

A practical drone design for planetary exploration. The football-sized surveillance variant carries cameras, microphones, gripping limbs and small reactors; the meter-long biological-analysis variant has many appendages and mechanical stomachs that analyze local organics in about a day. Both can change color with limited pattern mimicry. Surveillance drones can relay live video and record speech but, lacking legs, cannot accelerate quickly.
